kids.body: If none of the conditions of AP-003B, C and D holds, the roll-hold reference is the roll angle.
Small roll angles: the reference is wings level.
Large roll angles: the reference is limited to 30 degrees with the sign of the roll angle.
Turn-knob command, "up to a 30 degree limit" in the natural-language text.

The fault code is a three-bit word, and zero means no failure (an axiom the FRET set does not state;
this variant of the model adds it).
With no failure, the selected value is the middle value of the three signals.
Fault code 1: average of signals a and b.
Fault code 2: average of signals a and c.
Fault code 4: average of signals b and c.
